description.zh: 地域ID，您可通过接口[DescribeRegions](~~143074~~)查看可用的地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the cluster. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
绑定标签的集群ID。若需要为多个集群同时添加标签，请单击**添加**并输入集群ID。

> - 一次最多为50个集群同时绑定标签。
> - 您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the cluster to which to add a tag. If you want to add a tag to multiple clusters, click **Add** and enter the cluster IDs.

> 

*   You can add tags to up to 50 clusters at a time.

*   You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs.
The type of the cluster. Set the value to **ALIYUN::ADB::CLUSTER**.
The tags to add to the cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ALIYUN::ADB::CLUSTER --resource-id am-bp1gfds6a32s90000 --tag Value=testvalue1 Key=testkey1 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'am-bp1gfds6a32s90000' --Tag.1.Key testkey1 --Tag.1.Value testvalue1 --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::ADB::CLUSTER' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
